description.value:
A street cocktail of immunoblockers and antipsychotics sold to the chromed. 100eb a dose (Premium).

Primary: restores 2d6 Humanity, never above the maximum therapy allows. Taken right away out of combat, it holds off EMP loss penalties and injuries. Lasts a month, or until a bad enough moment cuts it short.

Secondary (Resist Torture/Drugs DV21): when it wears off on a failure, the Humanity it gave is lost and the deferred penalties land at once; −2 to all checks for 20 rounds, and unless you take 2 more doses as an Action in that time, 4d6 Humanity Loss (not lowering maximum Humanity). Dropping below 0 hands the character to the GM in Extreme Cyberpsychosis, with +2 to checks, until Humanity is positive again.

Enough doses also bring someone out of Extreme Cyberpsychosis: Humanity freezes at the final dose until they receive at least Standard Therapy. Not technically addictive.
